default_stack.state_authority: SQLiteVersionedRepository + SQLiteAppendOnlyLedger (LOCAL) or GitHub JSON observed-HEAD CAS (CHATGPT_GITHUB)

known_limitations: semantic generation/research quality depends on capabilities actually available in the active host session
without an always-on free host, between-session work cannot execute continuously
same-model self-critique/debate is not independent verification and cannot raise assurance to INDEPENDENT without real evidence
parent upcall and hierarchy contracts are implemented in UAOS but each child runtime still needs live integration evidence before claiming end-to-end coverage
high-impact external self-modification remains approval/policy gated
account-level ChatGPT Custom Instructions cannot be transactionally controlled by this repository and therefore are optional non-authority pointers only
business repositories may retain denied historical/internal files, but normal UAOS retrieval excludes superseded controller surfaces
the current ChatGPT raw connector surface cannot be physically intercepted by UAOS Python gates; repository-scoped credentials/tool mediation/rulesets are required for full physical enforcement
